outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single computed percentage (illumination overhead) per exposure-time condition, not an average across replicates/experiments requiring individual data points; it functions as an illustrative bar-style diagram of a fixed value, not a statistical summary.
Panel B is a line plot (photobleaching decay curves) with shaded mean±s.e.m. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel C is a scatter plot (ΔROS vs exposure time) with error bars and a fitted curve. Scatter plots already show individual measurements/conditions, so no additional overlay is needed.
Panel D consists of line plots showing individual migration tracks per cell; these are line plots (exempt) and already depict individual-cell data rather than an average.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed with individual data points (black dots) overlaid for each cell, satisfying the requirement.
Panel F consists of micrographs (Mitotracker/Paxillin/merge images), not a plot showing averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel G is a micrograph time-series, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H is a micrograph time-series, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel I is a line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel J is a line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
